articles.headline: Xbox’s first chief operating officer is out after just a few months
keyFacts: Xbox chief operating officer Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft today after 21 years at the company, according to an internal memo.
Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced the departure in a memo, stating that Chiang's responsibilities will be split among other leaders for now.
Microsoft declined to discuss the circumstances of Chiang's exit, citing a policy against discussing individual personnel matters.
body: Xbox’s first chief operating officer (COO) is leaving after the new role was created just a few months ago. Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft today, according to an internal Xbox memo seen by The Verge. Chiang has been at Microsoft for 21 years, serving as the head of Minecraft before being promoted to Xbox chief operating officer in July.
Xbox’s first chief operating officer is out after just a few months
Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft after 21 years.
Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft after 21 years.

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced Chiang’s departure in a surprisingly short memo today. “Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft today. I’m grateful for her years of service and wish her well,” said Sharma. As Chiang is departing today, her immediate responsibilities are being split up between other Xbox leaders for now, and Sharma notes that “We’ll share more on COO leadership as plans are finalized.”

That sounds like the COO position isn’t going away after just a few months, but it’s not clear why Chiang is departing after such a short stint in the role. At the time of Chiang’s promotion, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma described the new chief operating officer role as a first for Xbox, “with end-to-end P&L responsibility across content, hardware, platform, and services.” The role was created as part of Xbox’s big “reset.”

Chiang reported directly to Sharma, and was promoted to “bring our businesses together under one operating model, making sure we make clear investment decisions, learn from our successes and failures, and hold ourselves accountable for results.”

Chiang departs amid rumors that Xbox is preparing more layoffs this month, in November, and January. The sudden and short memo from Sharma, coupled with Chiang’s responsibilities being assigned to other Xbox leaders, makes it seem like this wasn’t a resignation.

I asked Microsoft to comment on Chiang’s departure, and the company refused to discuss the circumstances of her exit. “We don’t discuss individual personnel matters,” says Kari Perez, Xbox vice president of communications. “We’re grateful for Helen’s years of service and wish her well.”

articles.headline: Belmont’s Curse Taught Me An Important Lesson About Parrying, Namely I Should Do It More
keyFacts: Kotaku reported that the video game Belmont’s Curse features overwhelming combat scenarios with numerous hazards and projectiles.
The author stated they struggled to defeat the boss Mammon using their preferred ranged and avoidant playstyle.
The author discovered that using the parry mechanic, as seen in professional speedruns, allowed them to finally defeat the boss.
body: Belmont’s Curse is not for the easily overwhelmed. At any given time, the game requires me to track rooms full of arrows, laser beams, axes, icicles, boulders, and birds, any one of which could be hurtling toward my person and often all of them are at once. Thankfully, protagonist Rose Belmont has been gifted with an arsenal of tools to assist her deadly travels in Casa de Dracula, but again: overwhelmed. After a certain point, there are too many tools to keep track of and I just fall back on the ones that have worked the best for me. But one thing I’ve appreciated about my time with Belmont’s CurseÂ is how it’s forced me out of that comfort zone.

I typically favor a ranged playstyle, preferring the spear and whip weapons because with them I can keep a healthy distance and still dish out pain. Movement tools like the air dash, thorn whip, and slide help on the defense side and I’ve come to rely on them almost exclusively. For me, the best and easiest way to avoid damage is to simply get the hell away from the damage. With this avoidant strategy, I’ve been having a pretty decent time until one boss: the miser Mammon.

Mammon is this big ugly “be thou not afraid?” biblically accurate angel-type creature that looks like a wheel with an eyeball in the middle. My first few attempts to bring him down went poorly. He likes to erratically bounces about the arena, spits lines of fire at different angles, and tracks Rose’s position before brutally slamming down on her. I was having a devil of a time avoiding those attacks, as running away from one often put me in the danger zone of another. I just could not move fast enough to get away.

Frustrated, I took a break, popping on a speedrun of the game just to see the tips and tricks the professionals use to get through it. Turns out they parry, a lot. I don’t like the parry as a defense mechanism in Belmont’s Curse for the same reason I don’t like it in other nonâClair ObscurÂ games: It’s hard to do that shit on the fly. That difficulty is compounded because, as I’ve mentioned, Belmont’s Curse likes to throw everything at you, everywhere, all at once. The only reason I like parrying in Expedition 33 is because you’re just standing still waiting for the attack. Trying to figure out timings when 9 million projectiles are headed at your face is a fool’s errand, especially when the movement mechanics feel more like muscle memory to me than something I have to actively time.

But shit, I’d like to finish the game this century so I gave it a shot and it’s infuriating how well it worked. Instead of another gauntlet of failures, I beat Mammon within a handful of tries after picking the game back up. You know how in Zelda games, after you get a new item in a dungeon, its boss is often themed specifically around that item? That’s what this felt like, even though I’d picked up the parry four or so bosses previously. Belmont’s Curse gives you the freedom to find your own playstyle, but every so often it offers a test to check for understanding. I like that, it prevents things from getting too rote or stale. I don’t think I have the capacity to put the parry into my regular rotation, but next time I get stuck, I know to reach into my bag of tricks for something new.

articles.headline: Sims Competitor InZoi Deletes “Uncomfortable” Post After Fan Pushback
keyFacts: Developer Krafton deleted a social media post for the life-simulation game InZoi after users complained that it was disturbing and alluded to pedophilia.
The official InZoi X account stated the post was intended to showcase playground improvements and promote an upcoming Celebrity DLC scheduled for December.
EA recently announced the pause of a Sims project alongside studio closures and layoffs, according to the article.
body: The ambitious life-simulation game InZoi was once heralded as a potential "Sims-killer"--a promising new title that fans of the genre could turn to following EA's relentless pursuit to monetize every aspect of The Sims 4. However, a lackluster early-access period and concerns over the game's liberal use of AI made for a rocky start. Over the past year and a half, developer Krafton has addressed some of the complaints leveled at the game, but now, it finds itself in hot water for a different reason.

Earlier today, the official InZoi X account shared a post depicting a balding man in a leather coat watching children play on a playground alongside the caption, "Just a peaceful day at the playground. Nothing unusual here... just ignore the bald guy" alongside an eyes emoji. Though the post is still up on the game's official Discord server, it was removed on X a few hours after it was initially posted due to users calling the post disturbing and pointing out that it seemed to allude to pedophilia. After removing the post, the account issued the following statement:
https://twitter.com/PlayinZOI/status/2113658775584608309?s=20

The account initially shared the post to showcase improvements being made to InZoi's playgrounds as well as promote the game's upcoming Celebrity DLC, which is slated to arrive this December. However, its easy to understand why fans had a negative reaction to the post--especially in light of recent events .

InZoi isn't the only life simulation game in the news for less-than-ideal reasons. After a brutal round of layoffs and announcing the closure of Mass Effect and Dragon Age studio BioWare, EA revealed that one of Maxis' ongoing Sims projects is being paused .

articles.headline: Premier League release statement as Issa Diop told he’s lucky to avoid red card
keyFacts: Ipswich defender Issa Diop received only a yellow card after tackling Nottingham Forest attacker James McAtee during a match.
The Premier League explained that the referee issued a yellow card for stopping a promising attack rather than denying a goal-scoring opportunity.
Match officials and player Issa Diop stated that a covering defender and a touch away from goal justified avoiding a red card.
body: Issa Diop was ‘so, so lucky’ to avoid being shown a red card after bringing James McAtee down as he raced through on goal.
The Ipswich defender was only given a yellow card for the poor challenge, which clattered the Nottingham Forest attacker.
Diop was only shown a yellow card after wiping out McAtee as he raced through on goal at Portman Road Getty
McAtee touched the ball past Diop and looked to be clean through on goal, but as he seemingly broke free, his opponent slid across his path, taking him out.
At first, referee Thomas Bramall didn’t even award a free-kick, despite the Moroccan international getting nowhere near the ball.
However, after the ball went out of play, the official paused the match as VAR took a look at the incident.
Bramall was then called over the VAR monitor, and he watched multiple replays of the tackle from Diop on McAtee.
Nottingham Forest manager Oliver Glasner was incensed on the touchline after seeing Diop originally avoid punishment.
And he was then left baffled again, as Bramall only opted to give the Ipswich centre-back a yellow card instead of red, pointing out that McAtee’s touch was going away from goal.
Diop ‘very lucky’ to avoid red
On talkSPORT’s commentary from Portman Road, Joe Shennan explained: “Diop is booked, it is a free-kick to Forest, but the referee rules that there is a covering defender.”
Dean Ashton then added: “I think he was saying it was the touch that took it away from goal, and I’m not so sure about it…
“He’s very lucky, Diop, a ludicrous decision to make that challenge when there’s no way McAtee has got the pace to outrun him.
“Just unbelievable to make that decision and so, so lucky for that to only be a yellow card.”
View Tweet: https://t.co/2Xmo64i1XC
After watching a few replays of the incident on the VAR monitor, Bramall decided to only give Diop a yellow Getty
Premier League explanation
After the incident, the Premier League confirmed the reasoning behind the decision to only book Diop.

In a post on their Match Centre account on X, they wrote: “After VAR review for a possible denial of an obvious goal-scoring opportunity (DOGSO), the referee issued a yellow card to Diop for stopping a promising attack.”
That came after Bramall said to VAR: “It’s a heavy touch, with the defender inside and he knocks the ball away from the goal – I’m going to go direct free-kick and yellow card.”

He then announced in the stadium: “After review, there is a foul by Ipswich No.6. However, because the player knocks it to the right side of the goal, the final decision is direct free-kick and a yellow card to No.6”.
Was it the right decision to book Diop?
Diop thinks it was correct for him to not be sent off for his challenge on McAtee, revealing his thoughts post-match.
He told Sky Sports: “I don’t think it’s a red. I went to tackle because I saw Leif Davis covering. He puts the ball wide and Leif was there to cover.
Fortunately for Diop, he had Davis with him and McAtee’s touch was going away from goal, so he avoided a red card Getty
“I don’t think it’s a red. I was quite confident about that.”
Meanwhile, Ashton admitted that Diop was lucky to not be sent off, but shared the same stance as the defender overall.
He said on talkSPORT: “Davis was pretty much next to McAtee; he would have been right there with him, so to me it’s not a denial of a goalscoring opportunity as he’s right there.
“If he was behind, fair enough, but he’s almost on his shoulder.
“If you’re sending someone off, it has to be absolutely clear that it’s a goalscoring opportunity and it wasn’t.
“Davis was there, and the touch was away from goal.”

articles.headline: Falcons scrub 'Nazi-like' imagery from viral throwback logo
keyFacts: Some observers on social media stated that the Atlanta Falcons' viral throwback helmet design resembled a Nazi insignia.
The Falcons changed their social media profile picture after the design sparked controversy among fans.
The Falcons have not yet commented on the controversy and will proceed with using the throwback helmet in their game against the 49ers.
body: It's throwback week in Atlanta, where the Falcons will pay tribute to a different era as they host the 49ers on Sunday.
The design itself isn't sitting well with some fans, though.

While the logo is an exact replica of what the franchise used as its primary icon from 1989-2002, the imagery of the logo plastered onto black, gold and cream-colored striping resembled a Nazi insignia in the eyes of some observers.
Here's what you need to know about the controversy and whether the Falcons have responded.
Falcons viral throwback logo controversy
The Falcons put their throwback logo, which will be worn on this weekend's helmets, on black, gold and cream-colored helmet striping, which some fans believed closely resembled Nazi imagery.
The tweet featuring the logo quickly went viral for the wrong reasons:
New PFP 👀 https://t.co/gBXWISJav4
— Atlanta Falcons (@AtlantaFalcons) October 21, 2026
The Falcons made the image their profile picture but have since changed the image while leaving the tweet untouched.

Atlanta used the logo itself as its primary icon from 1989-2002, but the uniforms were set to be a throwback to the 1966 look that featured a red helmet with gold, white and black stripes, similar to the background of the image the team posted.
This is the 1966 helmet that the Falcons are referencing:

To the vastly uneducated, this bird was the Falcons logo from 1966 to 2002. The red and black honor Georgia and the gold honors Georgia Tech. We wear these every year as throwbacks. This is nothing new https://t.co/sFMGaKtl8T
— Chanluh 🪐 (@chxnluh) October 22, 2026

While the Falcons changed their profile picture, they will be going forward with the throwback helmet, which features the stripes running down the middle rather than running behind the logo at any point. The Falcons' new profile picture features the helmet with the throwback logo in front of a plain red background.
Falcons response to throwback logo controversy
The Falcons have not yet commented on the controversy surrounding their throwback logo.

It would be hard to say the logo itself is controversial, as it was used in some form by the Falcons for decades and has been prominent in throwback sets over the years. The placement of the logo on top of the stripes from the 1966 helmet, however, upset some fans.

articles.headline: Mass Effect Fans Call for EA Boycott as Petition to Save BioWare's Canceled Game Garners More than 75,000 Signatures
keyFacts: EA announced on October 21 that it is shutting down BioWare and canceling the next Mass Effect game.
Mass Effect fans launched a petition with over 75,000 signatures and called for a boycott of all EA products and services.
Industry analysts and former BioWare bosses stated that it is unlikely EA will listen to the demands of fans.
body: Mass Effect fans are calling for a boycott of all EA products and services in protest of the company closing down BioWare and canceling the next Mass Effect game.

It’s a rough time for Mass Effect fans. On October 21, EA announced its plans to shut down BioWare , a 30-year-old studio that spearheaded RPGs in the West with titles like Dragon Age, Jade Empire, Baldur’s Gate, and of course, Mass Effect .
Players were eagerly awaiting news of the next game in BioWare’s beloved sci-fi franchise — but EA shut that down, too, revealing in a statement that the project was officially canceled.

In the two days since then, fans of BioWare and the Mass Effect series have gathered together to call for action, begging EA to at least sell off BioWare’s IP to other studios rather than letting them languish. In fact, tensions have become so strained that players are now calling for an outright boycott of EA’s products and services until something is done.
On Reddit, several threads are rallying Mass Effect fans to gather under the hashtag #savemasseffect, urging players to take action and make their voices heard.

“WE HAVE TO DO SOMETHING! Guys we have to start something here and cry out loud enough that this game can be saved. Either EA making it or selling it off. We have to do it now before the noise on this game quiets down and it becomes another cancelled series, never to return,” one Redditor wrote . “I suggest we start a movement, and message the hell out of EA asking for some kind of outcome that gets this game finished. THIS GAME FINISHED.”

“Mass Effect is one of the better RPGs out today,” another fan wrote in a post titled ‘EA Boycott!’ “...Unless they sell Mass Effect to another studio or bring it back. I will never buy another EA product ever. They are already not one of my favorite studios. No more Respawn Entertainment, DICE, Motive Studios, Criterion Games, Maxis, Full Circle, Cliffhanger Games, or any EA Sports.

“I hope I'm not alone in this. We need to stand up and make our voices heard. I posted on everything I can. We can't let Mass Effect die so easily. Private investors need to realize how badly EA screwed up.”

These calls for a boycott coincide with a fanmade petition urging EA to either sell off the IPs to other developers or hand development of Mass Effect 5 to a different studio. At the time of writing, this petition has garnered over 76,500 signatures and counting as more fans and friends of the industry pile in.

Mass Effect 5 — which was reportedly expected to be called Mass Effect Universe — seems to have already been a good way into its development cycle, judging by a full-length trailer that was leaked online yesterday. This trailer rubbed even more salt in the wound for players, many of whom believed this game would be everything fans had been asking for and more.

Industry vets and even voice actors from the Mass Effect games are speaking out in hopes of somehow, some way, getting this game on shelves. But according to industry analysts and former BioWare bosses , it’s not likely that EA will listen to fans’ demands.

articles.headline: Ilhan Omar doubles down on ‘real name’ when confronted at Mall of Somalia
keyFacts: Rep. Ilhan Omar told Fox News Digital that her real name is Ilhan Abdullahi Omar after federal court filings used a different name.
Federal prosecutors referred to the congresswoman using a last name matching her ex-husband amid an ongoing immigration fraud investigation.
Omar's spokesperson denied the name claims as completely false and called allegations regarding her ex-husband a disgusting conspiracy theory.
body: Rep. Ilhan Omar told Fox News Digital that her "real name" is "Ilhan Abdullahi Omar" after a federal court filing identified the congresswoman by a last name matching that of her ex-husband, whom reports have alleged is her brother.
"Ilhan Abdullahi Omar, you know it," Omar told Fox News Digital when asked about her name. "It’s Ilhan Abdullahi Omar."
Omar was spotted by Fox News Digital at the Karmel Mall of Somalia in Minnesota as she made her way into the Karmel Masjid, inside the mall, for Friday prayers.
ILHAN OMAR CALLS TRUMP ‘CREEP’ AS PRESIDENT REVIVES ‘FAKE NAME,’ MARRIAGE ALLEGATIONS

Her comments come after two people familiar with the ongoing investigation into the Somali-born congresswoman, including a law enforcement source, said that her real name is Ilhan Nur Said Elmi. The last name is the same as her ex-husband, Ahmed Nur Said Elmi, who is alleged to be her brother.

Federal prosecutors referred to the Minnesota Democrat as "Ilhan Nur Said Elmi, a/k/a Ilhan Abdullahi Omar," in a Wednesday filing in D.C. federal court, as first reported by Fox News Digital. One source said the language used for her name in the filing reflected the evidence that has so far been compiled in the immigration fraud investigation .
ILHAN OMAR HIT WITH EXPULSION THREAT AS GOP LAWMAKER VOWS TO BOOT HER FROM CONGRESS OVER DOJ PROBE
One source disputed Omar’s account of her name, telling Fox News Digital, ‘That’s not her real name.’

U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro filed a motion on Wednesday seeking to prevent the federal search warrant for the congresswoman’s home from being unsealed, which was requested by several media outlets. The motion says the federal government is not yet finished executing the search warrant , and that it shouldn’t be unsealed yet.
ILHAN OMAR'S SISTER QUESTIONED BY FEDS AFTER DRAMATIC DC HOME RAID

"Before the Court are three Applications to unseal ex parte materials and proceedings related to a federal search warrant for the personal residence in the District of Columbia of Congresswoman Ilhan Nur Said Elmi, a/k/a Ilhan Abdullahi Omar…" the motion begins.
If proven in court that the congresswoman was not using her "real name," every single form she ever filled out could be subject to investigation, a former Minnesota federal immigration judge said.

Omar’s spokesperson repeatedly denied the claim, telling Fox News Digital on Thursday that the reports of her name being "Ilhan Nur Said Elmi" are "completely false," then proceeding with an attack on Fox News. The spokesperson also denied that Omar was once married to her brother, calling the claims a "disgusting conspiracy theory."

Omar’s residence in Washington, D.C., was raided by Homeland Security Investigations earlier this month as part of a probe into whether she or her father committed immigration fraud when becoming naturalized citizens. Federal authorities have since issued subpoenas to members of Omar’s family and seized her cellphone.
Fox News Digital’s Peter D’Abrosca and Kiera McDonald contributed to this report.

articles.headline: Nintendo's Shigeru Miyamoto says even if gen-AI "were to eventually handle everything, there will always be a role left" for human designers
keyFacts: Nintendo developer Shigeru Miyamoto stated that generative AI will not replace human designers because computers only serve as labor assistants.
Miyamoto will receive the Order of Culture from the Emperor of Japan next month, becoming the first video game developer to earn the honor.
While several major game studios are adopting generative AI, former Nintendo executive Doug Bowser stated Nintendo games will retain a human touch.
body: Legendary Nintendo developer Shigeru Miyamoto - who led development on classic games such as Super Mario 64 and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time - has argued that the rise of generative AI tools won't necessarily replace human talent.

Next month, Shigeru Miyamoto will become the first ever video game developer to be awarded the Order of Culture by the Emperor of Japan, a hugely prestigious honour. But in a recent press conference dedicated to the award, he also shared some thoughts about gen-AI and its use in game production.

"Our generation lived through a period of rapid computer development - a time when tools were constantly evolving, moving from typewriters to word processors,” he said while speaking to the press, in quotes translated by VGC. Miyamoto argued that a designer's true capabilities "finally came to the fore" as technology advanced and was capable of handling more of what might be considered "labor", and a similar transition may take place with generative AI tech.

"While the act of creation is inherently satisfying, there's a danger: one might find satisfaction in the labor itself and mistakenly believe that a high-quality piece of work has been created," he added. If generative-AI software replaces more tasks involved in game production, human game devs might have "an opportunity to reflect on what's really important."

"Looking back at past designs, there are some that were created merely by copying and pasting. Yet, such work rarely stands the test of time; it lacks the individual’s particular design intention," Miyamoto continued. "Because the process relies on an individual's intent, with the computer serving as an assistant for the labor, I believe that even as technology continues to evolve, and even if AI were to eventually handle everything, there will always be a role left for us to play."

Masahiro Sakurai was a bit less optimistic about a potentially AI-first future than his peer. The Smash Bros. director recently said gen-AI tech might lead to a surge of unoriginal and unprofitable games, though it won't be able to replicate the creativity of humans.

Nintendo itself hasn't outright ruled out the possibility of using gen-AI tools in the future, but former Nintendo of America president Doug Bowser assured folks that the company's games would retain a "human touch" last year. "We still believe that what makes our games special is our developers, their artistic capabilities, their insight into how people play," Bowser said at the time.

Nintendo is somewhat at odds with several of its contemporaries when it comes to AI adoption, however. Square Enix CEO Takashi Kiryu previously said the company would be "aggressive in applying AI." Sega, Capcom, Level-5, Epic Games and a number of other high-profile game studios have admitted to using gen-AI in some form, as well. Xbox even opened an entire division seemingly dedicated to experimenting with the tech.

articles.headline: There's a third PHP2Shell bug, but it won't get an emergency fix
keyFacts: Researchers discovered a third remote code execution vulnerability in PHP, designated CVE-2026-115560 by the PHP Foundation.
The PHP Foundation stated the flaw will not receive an emergency fix because it requires an unlikely configuration and can be mitigated by changing a setting.
Security researchers documented exploitation attempts for the earlier PHP2Shell bugs, though no confirmed successful compromises were publicly reported.
body: As the PHP2Shell chaos continues, researchers have found a third PHP vulnerability that could allow attackers to take over websites or remotely run malware on vulnerable systems. But this one won’t receive an emergency fix.

The PHP Foundation on Friday told The Register that it has reserved a CVE identifier (CVE-2026-115560) for a third RCE flaw to go with the first two that comprise PHP2Shell, and it will release a full advisory and fixed software with the next regular PHP release.

CVE-2026-115560 “requires a very unlikely combination of configuration and specific PHP application code, which we do not expect to occur in practical use of PHP,” Elizabeth Barron, executive director of the PHP Foundation, told The Register . “The issue can be mitigated with a configuration setting. So for the moment the PHP Security Team has only published an informational advisory on the PHP website, explaining exactly this situation.”
The informational advisory, published on Friday, suggests that users “set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 until the next regular bugfix release, to fully protect from an unlikely RCE vector.”

These unlikely RCE attacks require an application to set “ session.serialize_handler to php_binary or php_serialize in its configuration and then switch it to php at runtime with ini_set() before calling session_start() .” Additionally, the session upload progress feature must be enabled.

This setup, according to the PHP Foundation, is unlikely in real-world applications, and as such doesn’t pose the same massive risk as the earlier two CVEs that set the internet on fire earlier this week.

Those, of course, are CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 , collectively called PHP2Shell . The related vulnerabilities involve memory-safety flaws in PHP, the open source programming language running on about 70 percent of websites with a known server-side programming language. The PHP Foundation officially disclosed and patched both bugs on Wednesday.

Despite reports of mass exploitation attempts , and multiple proof-of-concept exploits both before and after the CVE disclosures, as of Friday there have been no publicly confirmed successful compromises attributed to PHP2Shell.

“We have no evidence of successful exploitation of the two vulnerabilities from Wednesday prior to disclosure, and we currently have no evidence of any exploitation of these vulnerabilities on patched PHP versions,” Barron said. “We received no further indication from OpenAI, Wiz or Calif, with whom we're working closely on this issue, regarding any issues on patched systems.”
The Register reached out to multiple other security researchers, all of whom said they’ve documented exploitation attempts - but no confirmed successful attacks in the wild.

“Nonetheless, exploitation may have already begun in a limited fashion and the threat is viable and very serious,” Mandiant Chief Technology Officer Charles Carmakal said in a Friday LinkedIn post. Google Cloud owns Mandiant, along with cloud security biz Wiz, which is one of the organizations credited with finding and reporting the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities.
Despite “no evidence of successful wide scale exploitation,” Carmakal noted that there are several exploit PoCs publicly circulating online.

Many of these, he said, “appear to be ‘vibe-coded’ and are incapable of remote code execution. We have validated some PoCs, however, that are capable of RCE against default deployments of mod_php but not PHP-FPM.”®

articles.headline: Leclerc sets Austin practice pace from Verstappen
keyFacts: Ferrari driver Charles Leclerc was fastest in the first practice session at the United States Grand Prix, leading Red Bull driver Max Verstappen by 0.084 seconds.
Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli finished fifth fastest while attempting to clinch his first world title this weekend.
Mercedes and Ferrari have both introduced car upgrades for the event, with Mercedes hoping to hone their set-up during practice sessions.
body: - Published
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc set the pace from Red Bull's Max Verstappen in first practice at the United States Grand Prix.
Leclerc was 0.084 seconds quicker than Verstappen at the start of the first weekend on which Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli can clinch his first world title.
The Italian was fifth fastest, 0.481secs off the pace, behind McLaren's Lando Norris and Mercedes' George Russell.
Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton was sixth ahead of McLaren's Oscar Piastri.
Antonelli will win the championship in Austin only if he wins the race and Russell finishes below eighth and Hamilton below fourth.
Mercedes have reverted both their cars to the upgraded specification that was introduced in Malaysia two races ago but about which there remain questions over its relative performance.

The team believe that the upgrade has more performance within it, but that they have not yet found the appropriate set-up to maximise it. They hope a full, 'normal' weekend with three practice sessions will enable them to hone it.
Ferrari have an upgrade here which is fundamentally a new floor. Both Leclerc and Hamilton played down its potential impact.
Hamilton said: "We have a very, very small upgrade this weekend. It's less than a tenth. It's like half a tenth.

"So, I don't think that propels us forward enough to necessarily challenge that deficit. But maybe the track suits our car, and maybe they'll have a one-off weekend. Maybe Mercedes will have an off weekend again, and we'll be right there to take it."

articles.headline: Joe Scarborough Skewers Republicans For ‘Becoming The Party Of Pedophile Protectors’
keyFacts: Television host Joe Scarborough criticized Donald Trump on Friday for defending a political attack ad used in the Ohio governor's race.
Scarborough stated that the ad, which targeted Democrat Amy Acton, highlighted a family history involving child sexual abuse allegations.
Scarborough accused Republicans of damaging their electoral prospects shortly before the upcoming election.
body: “Morning Joe” host Joe Scarborough gave Donald Trump a hellish scolding Friday for his pre-midterm antics.

The MS NOW star told the president that “Americans aren’t as stupid as you think they are” and that Republicans’ “closing argument” before the election has failed for what has become “the party of pedophile protectors.”

The host drilled the president over defending Vivek Ramaswamy’s outrageous attack ad on Democratic opponent Amy Acton in the Ohio governor’s race, which featured Acton’s estranged mother, Donna Arthur, calling her a liar and urging residents not to vote for her. Arthur lost custody of Acton when she was a child after Acton accused her stepfather, Cledith “Bud” Arthur, of sexually abusing her when she was 9, up until she was 12 years old. Her mother then fled the state with the criminally charged stepfather.

Scarborough said, “You know, Donald, Americans aren’t as stupid as you think they are. And you certainly know that if your father had been accused of raping you and your sister and you had to be taken out of the home when you were 11 years, 12 years old, and your mother had fled the state with the rapist, with a child rapist. Yeah, the press would all be criticizing that ad. And you know that. This isn’t about the press.”
He continued, “I mean, it’s so stupid. I cannot believe how stupid this is. What you’re doing in the final stages of this campaign to hurt Republicans. I really can’t.”
Scarborough reminded Trump that Ohio’s current GOP governor and a Republican senator have objected to the ad.
“I don’t know if you think that you’re talking to 3-year-olds and they don’t understand, but Americans understand,” Scarborough said. “They understand. And for Republicans, this is horrible news.”

“You start the week defending, getting in bed with Vladimir Putin, doing everything you can to destroy freedom fighters in Ukraine, doing everything you can to undermine Western democracy, to undermine Western civilization. And then you follow with this?” Scarborough asked.

“Listen, man, it’s 11 days. In 11 days, Americans vote. And you’re talking about this at a time when people can’t afford their lives,” he said, referring to high prices on the heels of Trump’s prolonged war of choice against Iran.

“Republicans are putting quite a closing argument forward,” the host said. “Now we’re used to seeing distractions in the final days before an election, but becoming the party of pedophile protectors?”

articles.headline: Android lets you ‘bubble’ apps for easy access now – how it works
keyFacts: Android has introduced app bubbles allowing users to keep up to five application icons on top of their screens for easy access.
The new feature is currently exclusive to Google Pixel devices as part of the Android rollout, but it will eventually expand to other manufacturers.
Users can activate the feature on a Pixel by long-pressing an app icon and selecting the bubble option from the menu.
body: ZDNET’s key takeaways
- Android 17 has introduced app bubbles.
- You can isolate an app so its icon is always on top.
- It’s a Pixel exclusive for now, but is coming to other phones.

Several years ago, Android introduced the ability to “bubble” a text conversation, or move that app to a floating bubble on your home screen. It’s a convenient way to keep a conversation easily accessible.
Now, you can bubble apps as well.

As part of the Android 17 rollout, users got the option to use app bubbles. When you bubble an app, it sits on top of everything else on your screen, making it easy to access when you need it. You can place up to five apps in your bubble.
More from ZDNET
How to bubble an app on a Google Pixel

The ability to bubble an app on Android is starting as a Pixel exclusive, but the feature will come to other manufacturers over time. There is an existing, similar feature for Samsung called Smart Pop Up View, and instructions for that are below.
1. Go to your home screen or app drawer
To get started, choose the app you want from either your app screen or your home screen.
2. Long-press the app you want to bubble
Press and hold on the app until a pop-up menu appears.
3. Choose bubble
The menu will show options like App info, Add app to home screen, or Pause app. Select the Bubble option.
4. Find a location

Your selected app will shrink to an icon that you can move around your home screen. You don’t have the freedom to place it anywhere, but it can go anywhere along the left or right side of your screen. The app will stay on top of everything else on your screen, and you can bubble multiple apps at once, but they will always move together.
How to bubble an app on a Samsung Galaxy

Samsung has a similar feature called Smart Pop-Up View that lets you respond to notifications on selected apps without leaving the app you’re in. You might need to enable your “Multi window for all apps” setting first.
1. Open Settings
Navigate to your settings app, open it, and select Notification Settings.
2. Choose Advanced settings
Once you’re in advanced settings, find and choose Floating Notifications. Then select Smart Pop-Up view.
4. Choose which apps you want
Now just select which apps you want to have priority.
